assessment: Alpha874 fixed a real same RegionHandle cross-simulator endpoint authority flaw. WorldModel apply_region previously kept avatars, old original Firestorm body pose, COF/Low158/Low382 wearable references, terrain and old object local IDs when the actual simulator IP or UDP port changed without a RegionHandle change. Explicit known socket change now resets region epoch/scene/appearance/pose/early-reply cache, matching real handoffs. Incomplete same-region handshake with empty IP or port zero preserves last known concrete simulator endpoint and cannot bypass the later socket-change detection. Native C++ regression proves same socket retains scene, new port or IP invalidates everything and fresh simulator pose and skin are needed; Python real source contract, Mint Linux-x64 GUI gate, Pi5 headless integration. Previous exact SHA Pi5 Alpha864 66e0211 Run 39977723209 success. OpenGenesisLINK main 08f95e7 unchanged since dedicated Voice #285. Real authenticated NexVerse AvatarAppearance/COF/Skin/Outfit GPU and simulator confirmed WASD/yaw live E2E still open, no deployment.
